faq.a: We design, install, maintain and take down Christmas lights for homes and businesses across Pearland, Manvel, Friendswood, League City, the Bay Area and Galveston County. You never touch a ladder.

faq.q: How do I get a price?
faq.a: Request a free estimate. We measure your home in about 30 minutes without climbing on the roof, and you don’t need to be home unless we need to get through a gate. In a hurry? Text us a few photos for a rough price. We’ll text or email your estimate, and you can sign it online.
Every home is different. We look at how much you want lit, the size and shape of your home, and how tricky it is to reach, then give you one clear price. What’s in your estimate is what you pay.

faq.q: Do you work on tile roofs?
faq.a: No. Clay and other tile roofs are too fragile to work on safely.
Yes: storefronts, restaurants, neighborhood entrances and more.
Installs start October 15th and fill up fast. Book early: installs done by the end of October get an early install discount.

faq.q: How long does it take? Do I need to be home?
faq.a: About 2 hours for most homes. You don’t need to be home. Just make sure we can reach your outdoor outlets and get through any gate.
Everything: lights, clips, cords, timers, design, installation and all-season service. It’s all measured and cut to fit your home, with no extra strands hanging off the roof.

faq.q: What kind of lights do you use?
faq.a: Commercial-grade LED only: brighter, cheaper to run, and sealed in plastic so they don’t break.

A deposit when you sign holds your install date. The rest is due once your lights are up, and removal is paid in January. Pay online by PayPal, Venmo or card from the link we send you, or by Zelle, check or cash.

faq.q: Can I see my account online?
faq.a: Yes. Sign in at christmas-light-creations.com/account with the email we send your estimates to (no password). You’ll see your agreements, what’s due and what you’ve paid, and you can pay online.

We beat it. Send us a written quote from another professional Christmas-light company for the same lights and service, and we’ll beat it by 10%. That’s for real holiday-lighting companies with insurance, not a handyman or a landscaper.

Texas sales tax is added as its own line when you buy new lights or lease them: a first-year install, an add-on, every lease payment. Re-installs of lights you already own aren’t taxed, and neither are service calls.

faq.q: Can I lease the lights instead of buying them?
faq.a: Yes. With a lease we keep the lights, and every year you choose a brand-new design or keep the one you had. Year one is full price; every year you come back takes another 10% off the original price, up to 50% off. Nothing to store, test or replace.

Any new install, bought or leased, paid in three equal payments instead of a deposit and a balance: the first when you sign, then one a month on the 1st or the 15th (you choose when you sign; we email you a payment link that morning). Everything is included, takedown too. No long-term commitment. It isn’t for re-installs of lights you already own. Ask us when you request your estimate.

Call or text and we’ll fix it free, with no limit: burned-out or unglued bulbs, timers, tripped outlets. Usually the same day locally, within 48 hours during the busiest weeks. If we can’t fix it, we replace it at no charge.

faq.q: When do you take them down?
faq.a: Between January 3rd and 13th. We take everything down, label it and box it up, and you store the boxes until next season.

faq.q: Is there a cost for removal?
faq.a: Yes, a set price shown in your estimate, due in January.

If you buy them, yes: once they’re paid for, they’re yours, and every year after we put them back up for about half the original price. If you lease, we keep them and you get a fresh design any year. Either way, we call in late summer to get you on the schedule.

faq.q: Can you hang lights I already own?
faq.a: No. We only install lights that came from us, so we can guarantee every bulb all season.

If you add lights (an arch, a tree, more roofline), the new part is charged in full that year. After that it adds about half its price to your yearly re-install. Your online account shows the full breakdown.

toneSamples.when: Customer says lights are off; things to try first.
toneSamples.subject: Quick checks for your lights
toneSamples.body:
Hi {first},

Sorry your lights are giving you trouble! A couple of quick things to check:
- Outdoor outlets (GFCI): press the "reset" button on the outlet, and check for another GFCI in the garage or a bathroom
- Timer: make sure it's plugged in all the way and switched to "timer" or "on"

If that doesn't do it, reply here or text {businessPhone} and we'll come take care of it, free.

Thank you,
{business}
{businessPhone}
